libvterm 0.3.3 is vendored unmodified from the author's official release:
https://www.leonerd.org.uk/code/libvterm/libvterm-0.3.3.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256: `09156f43dd2128bd347cbeebe50d9a571d32c64e0cf18d211197946aff7226e0`

License: MIT, preserved in `libvterm/LICENSE`. The release includes its generated
encoding and Unicode-width tables; CMake builds the nine C source files directly,
so no libtool, Perl, ncurses, external runtime library or network download is
needed to compile the app. The original release's tests and documentation are
retained alongside the source. No upstream source patches are applied.
